subject: Recap: Atlas AI pilot pricing, model split & procurement path
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Bell <sara.bell@atlasai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Atlas AI pilot pricing, model split & procurement path

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap so we all have the same thread and a clear set of next steps. I’ve attached a simple workbook with the token estimates and two pricing scenarios.

Call highlights and requested targets
- Expected pilot traffic (prod-like): ~25M tokens / month (baseline).
- Atlas target unit: ~$900 per 1M tokens (goal for hosted pilot).
- Technical requirement: 99th pctl latency < 500ms for user-chat paths.

Proposed model mix (current ask & suggested split)
- Chat (conversational UI): 60% => ~15M tokens/mo
- Embeddings (semantic search / recall): 30% => ~7.5M tokens/mo
- Rerank (re-ranking candidate sets): 10% => ~2.5M tokens/mo

Two pricing pathways (estimates in attached workbook):
1) Hosted (managed) — cost-optimized plan: ~$790 / 1M tokens (batch + prefix caching, mixed-precision embed) — simple onboarding, 30 day free trial credits.
2) Dedicated (reserved GPUs) — SLA & capacity guarantee: ~$640 / 1M tokens with a 6–12 month commit (lower unit, higher upfront).

Model variants & routing suggestions
- Chat: prioritize latency-optimized chat model for interactive sessions; fallback to cost-optimized chat for background tasks.
- Embeddings: use quantized embed variant for bulk vectorization; keep a non-quantized option for adversarial or high-precision cases.
- Rerank: light-weight reranker for small candidate sets; consider batch rerank for bulk jobs.

Open questions for Atlas to confirm (helps refine numbers):
1) What portion of chat traffic is short-turn (<=64 tokens) vs long-turn (>256 tokens)?
2) Any compliance constraints that require Private/VPC deployment for the pilot?
3) Procurement timeline & PO owner (procurement contact or internal owner) — helps us scope dedicated vs hosted.

Next steps / asks
- Sara: confirm preferred pricing pathway (hosted vs dedicated) and share procurement contact if different from this thread.
- Atlas: confirm short-turn vs long-turn ratio (ballpark is fine).
- Redwood: Vivek and I will run a delta costing that includes an embed-quantized scenario and a dedicated-commit estimate.

Attachments: Atlas_pilot_token_estimates.xlsx (Excel, 54KB)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a brief mutual action plan (MAP) once I get the procurement timing.

—
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: Atlas_pilot_token_estimates.xlsx]

From: Sara Bell <sara.bell@atlasai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Atlas AI pilot pricing, model split & procurement path

Thanks Irene — this is super helpful. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- We like the hosted option to avoid procurement lag; target is to keep unit cost <= $900/1M. Hosted path sounds doable.
- Short-turn vs long-turn: roughly 70% short-turn (<=64 tokens) for chat, 30% long-turn (>256).
- Procurement: looping in our procurement team — procurement@atlasai.com — for PO/terms (cc’d). They’ll flag any needed paperwork; security questionnaire is likely.

Can Redwood share the MAP and the dedicated vs hosted delta (we want both figures for internal approval)? If hosted is close to $790 and you can lock in initial credits for the pilot, that will keep us moving fast.

Thanks,
Sara
VP Product | Atlas AI
Sara.Bell@atlasai.com

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 5:12 PM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Recap: Atlas AI pilot pricing, model split & procurement path (internal)

Looping in a quick technical note for the commercial draft: 
- We can shift embeddings to the quantized embed-2q variant and retain ~95% quality for Atlas’ use-case. Estimate: ~35% cost reduction on the embed line item.
- Rerank is already fairly cheap; if Atlas keeps candidate sets <= 10 we see negligible cost impact.
- For the short-turn heavy profile (70% short-turn) we should model a higher cache hit-rate — that should reduce per-token outgoing cost in hosted by ~10–15% relative to flat assumptions.

Irene: I’ll prepare a quick cost table with \"hosted - cache uplift\" and \"dedicated - commit uplift\" columns. ETA 3 hours.

—Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[internal note: include quantized embed SKU and dedicated pricing for 3/6/12 month commits]

- Joint: 1-week pilot kickoff window once PO or verbal commit in place.

I’ve attached a 1-page MAP + the token-estimates workbook. If you confirm hosted, we’ll include an initial $10k credit offset for pilot consumption and lock in the hosted pricing for 30 days to allow procurement to complete.
